# Lab 11.5: Real-time AI Enrichment

## What We Are Going to Do
Call a Gemini model inside a continuous query to classify each new ride's feedback as it arrives, then delete the reservation.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create a remote model.** Replace `YOUR_PROJECT`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab11.gemini
REMOTE WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (endpoint = 'gemini-3.5-flash');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The `lab_conn` service account needs **Vertex AI User** (granted in Lab 7.7). Also grant the `bq-continuous` service account **BigQuery Connection User** (done in Lab 11.1).

2. **[SQL] Create the target table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab11.feedback_classified (ride_id STRING, feedback STRING, category STRING, ride_ts TIMESTAMP);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Start the continuous AI query.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">INSERT INTO lab11.feedback_classified
SELECT ride_id, feedback, TRIM(ml_generate_text_llm_result) AS category, ride_ts
FROM ML.GENERATE_TEXT(
  MODEL lab11.gemini,
  (SELECT ride_id, feedback, ride_ts,
          CONCAT('Classify this ride feedback as one word: POSITIVE, DRIVER_ISSUE or VEHICLE_ISSUE. Feedback: ', feedback) AS prompt
   FROM APPENDS(TABLE lab11.rides, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)),
  STRUCT(TRUE AS flatten_json_output, 10 AS max_output_tokens)
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[CLI] Generate rides and read the results.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">./gen_rides.sh
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT feedback, category FROM lab11.feedback_classified ORDER BY ride_ts DESC LIMIT 10'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Cancel the query and delete the reservation.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq ls -j --max_results=20 | grep -i running
bq cancel &lt;RUNNING_JOB_ID&gt;
bq rm --reservation_assignment &lt;ASSIGNMENT_NAME_FROM_bq_ls&gt;
bq rm --reservation --location=US lab-cq</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Model | Remote Gemini model over `us.lab_conn` |
| Each new row | Classified seconds after insert |
| Cost | Vertex AI tokens + reservation slots |
| Clean-up | Reservation deleted |
